Rae (CS): Quick ask — NovoThera requested a 75m "Onboarding + Quickstarts" session next Fri. Need to lock facilitators, attendee cap, and an access checklist. :calendar:
Omar - Enablement: I can run the content and walkthrough. Recommend max 8 seats. Will prepare slides + a 1p pre-read.
Luca_CSM: They said 6 engineers across infra and app teams. Heads-up: procurement might slip, please flag any renewal risk in the session.
Jess_Support: I'll provision short-lived tokens and a disposable org for the hands-on. Sample script (internal):
```
curl -X POST https://internal.redwood/api/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer $ADMIN" -d '{"scope":"onboard","ttl":"2h"}'
```
Rae (CS): Draft agenda: 10m intro & success criteria, 25m quickstart walkthrough, 30m guided tasks (timeboxed), 10m wrap & next steps. Add a 5m renewal-signal check at the end?
Omar - Enablement: Yes — I'll split the guided tasks into two 15m checkpoints with clear acceptance checks in the pre-read so we don't overrun.
SchedulerBot: Event created: NovoThera Onboarding Quickstart — Fri 09:00 PT. Calendar invites sent. :white_check_mark:
Luca_CSM: I'll run a 15m pre-sync with the customer tomorrow to confirm attendees and procurement status; will update this thread with attendee list and any blockers.
